response.justification: While the candidate is a highly experienced software engineer with a strong background in web and full-stack development, they fall significantly short of the mandatory requirements for this role. They lack the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ development on the Windows platform, possessing only a few months of professional C/C++ experience. Furthermore, they do not have the necessary domain expertise in Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Fixed Income.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple modern tech stacks.
Demonstrated exposure to the financial sector through previous work at an investment tech company.
Strong background in software craftsmanship, TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and technical leadership.
concerns: Lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience, with only 7 months listed professionally.
Missing required Windows platform development experience, favoring Linux and web ecosystems.
Does not possess the required Capital Markets or Fixed Income domain knowledge.
